title: PKU2U authentication using online identities must be prevented.
check_content:
If the following registry value does not exist or is not configured as specified, this is a finding:

Registry Hive: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE
Registry Path: \SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\LSA\pku2u\

Value Name: AllowOnlineID

Value Type: REG_DWORD
Value: 0
fixtext: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Windows Settings >> Security Settings >> Local Policies >> Security Options >> "Network security: Allow PKU2U authentication requests to this computer to use online identities" to "Disabled".
VulnDiscussion: PKU2U is a peer-to-peer authentication protocol.   This setting prevents online identities from authenticating to domain-joined systems.  Authentication will be centrally managed with Windows user accounts.
